units: AttributionClass enumerates noise, state, mechanism, representation, and generator.
ResidualAttribution stores five scalar attribution values, can return dictionary vector, and chooses dominant source by maximum value.
MRATRouter has noise_threshold and saturation_threshold; only saturation_threshold is used in route.
If residual_error <= expected_noise, route assigns all attribution to noise.
Else if mechanism_failure_signal >0.7, route assigns that signal to mechanism before normalization.
Else if representation_capacity < saturation_threshold, representation receives 1-representation_capacity.
Otherwise route assigns all attribution to state.
Generator attribution is initialized to zero and is never made nonzero by route.
Attribution values are normalized to a simplex; all-zero fallback is uniform 0.2 over five classes.
Routing is deterministic threshold logic over supplied inputs, not a validated causal attribution estimator.
Frozen route implementation has no branch that attributes generator failure.
noise_threshold constructor field is not used in the route decision.
PTVS package exports PTVSAnalyzer, ConstraintChecker, and compute_lbr.
ConstraintResult stores satisfied flag, constraint name, optional violation type, and metadata.
Constraint wraps an evaluator callable mapping prediction and observation to boolean admissibility plus violation metadata.
Constraint.evaluate executes evaluator and returns ConstraintResult, clearing violation type on success.
ConstraintChecker maintains a list of constraints, evaluates all, tests all-satisfied admissibility, and returns failed constraints.
Checker docstring states it produces raw admissibility telemetry without attribution or correction.
Code does not provide a domain-general method for choosing or validating environmental constraints.
EnvironmentState stores step, arbitrary state, and metadata.
PTVSEnvironment holds step count, a ConstraintChecker, and history; concrete tasks are expected to subclass it.
Base reset returns state=None at step 0 and clears history.
observe and transition are abstract by NotImplementedError.
evaluate_prediction delegates to ConstraintChecker.evaluate; is_admissible delegates to checker.
generate_consequence calls observe and returns prediction, observed state, and admissibility result.
Environment creates empirical consequence but does not decide how agent adapts.
No concrete RAHU environment subclasses are present under src/ at frozen head.
Fixture environments later pass shift_rate/noise/failure_mode/consequence_coupling arguments that base PTVSEnvironment does not accept.
compute_lbr returns invalid_trajectories/total_trajectories with zero-total returning 0.
compute_step_lbr derives invalid count from event admissible labels.
compute_violation_rate summarizes already supplied violation_type labels among invalid events.
summarize_telemetry returns trajectory count, invalid count, LBR, and violation distribution.
Metric comments state violation-type summarization does not itself perform attribution.
TelemetryEvent stores step, prediction, observation, admissibility, optional violation type, and metadata.
record appends one event with supplied admissibility and metadata.
Analyzer reports total event count and violation count.
compute_lbr returns violation_count/total_events with zero events returning 0.
get_violation_history filters inadmissible events; summarize exports totals, LBR, and violation metadata.
Telemetry explicitly measures empirical friction without deciding noise/mechanism/representation cause.
